what_happened: The job "Make readings state GitHub Actions cache branch scoping for CI work" (prompts) was rejected. The producer added the cache-scoping rule to reader.md, but the verifier marked 2 of 6 acceptance criteria unmet. (1) The rule is not its own bullet. It is joined onto the previous bullet at reader.md:7. (2) The governance and trim criterion failed. The existing reader.md guidance was cut in meaning, not only in wording (reader.md:3-9). The verifier gave 3 major findings. They are the joined bullet, the guidance removed at lines 3-9, and the change fitting the token budget by deleting a newline and existing guidance instead of finding a real wording saving. No check failed.
cause: The reader prompt had almost no token room, and nothing told the producer how much room was left or which existing text carries rules. To fit the new bullet, the producer cut guidance and merged bullets. The distinction between trimming wording and removing meaning was judged only by the final verifier. Nothing compared the old and new bullet lists before verification. Nothing required the producer to keep the bullet count and the meaning of each old bullet.
prevention: Before dispatch, compute the remaining token room for any prompt a request edits and put the figure in the reading. After the producer edits, run a code check on the prompt diff. It must confirm that every old bullet is still present as its own bullet, that any new rule is a separate bullet, and that the budget test passes. It should list the removed lines for the producer to justify before the job goes to the verifier. If the room is smaller than the new text, the reading should name which wording to shorten first.
proposed_request: Add one bullet to crates/athena-context/prompts/reader.md. It must say that when a request touches CI caching or CI speed, the reading states how the GitHub Actions cache is scoped by branch and puts that constraint in an acceptance criterion. Acceptance: the new rule is its own separate bullet; every existing bullet in reader.md is still present as its own bullet with the same meaning; only wording is shortened (no guidance deleted, no bullets merged) so the prompt fits its token budget; no governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) change; cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy and cargo test pass, including the budgets tests. First measure how many tokens of room reader.md has, and in the change record list each shortened phrase with its before and after wording.
